svg.title: Rishikesh Kallapally — backend and full-stack developer
svg.desc: Animated banner: name, Electronics and Instrumentation at NIT Silchar, class of 2027; a typing line cycling through Spring Boot APIs, full-stack React apps, LLM tools in Java, query tuning and ML on a microcontroller; and an editor window showing DriveController.java from placement-prep, fed by glowing circuit traces, answering GET /api/drives/eligible with 200 OK.
